correctness.rationale: For d=w+z and H={0,d}, rederived f_c(s)=s+c+d 1{bar(s+c)=bar w}; functional Yang-Baxter identity holds because its correction depends only on V/H. Each local sweep adds e_i=c+d A_i to both site and carrier; modulo H, A_i(t)=1{bar(x_i(0)+b0(0)+i c+t(m+1)c)=bar w}. For odd m or c in H, T²=I; otherwise invariant two-sweep B_i moves each site by d B_i, giving T^4=I and Fix(T²)=q(q-4)^m. One-sweep zero-increment count gives Fix(T)=q(q-2)^m when c=0, q 2^m when c=d, otherwise zero. Hence cycles C1=F1,C2=(F2-F1)/2,C4=(q^(m+1)-F2)/4. The two-point nonzero correction is nonaffine since a nonconstant affine H-valued map has q/2>=4 nonzero inputs. Independent exhaustive full-state sweeps tested 72 parameter/length cases in F2^3 and verified all period and fixed counts.
